name: Extract Method
description: Move a coherent fragment into a new well-named function and call it from the original site.

name: Inline Method
description: Replace calls to a trivial function with its body and delete it when the indirection adds nothing.

name: Extract Variable
description: Give a complicated expression a named local so its intent reads directly in the code.

name: Replace Temp with Query
description: Swap a temporary holding a computed value for a function that computes it on demand.

name: Introduce Parameter Object
description: Bundle values that always travel together into one struct and pass that instead.

name: Preserve Whole Object
description: Pass the whole object rather than plucking out several of its fields first.

name: Replace Conditional with Polymorphism
description: Move each branch of a type-tag conditional into that type's own method behind a shared interface.

name: Replace Magic Number with Named Constant
description: Replace a bare literal with a named constant that states what the value means.

name: Decompose Conditional
description: Extract the condition and each branch of a tangled conditional into named functions.

name: Consolidate Duplicate Conditional Fragments
description: Hoist code repeated in every branch of a conditional out to before or after it.

name: Extract Interface
description: Define an interface for just the methods a caller needs so it depends on behavior, not a concrete type.

name: Move Method
description: Relocate a method onto the type whose data it mostly works with.

name: Hide Delegate
description: Add a method on the direct dependency so callers stop traversing through it to a further object.

name: Remove Middle Man
description: Let callers talk to the real object directly and delete the forwarding layer.
